## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Kilocode Vitest 5.0.5 security update CLI-ACTIONABLE (deps, security, vitest, test-infrastructure)

- **What**: Kilocode PR #15437 (merged 2026-10-23) bumps vitest to 5.0.5 (from 4.1.11 in kilo-docs and ^4.0.16 in plugin-atomic-chat), which brings `@vitest/mocker` 5.0.5 and resolves **GHSA-qxg6-89mg-rqv8** and **GHSA-xp26-3454-mjgp** (both patched in vitest 4.1.12+). Issue: vitest <4.1.12 has two security advisories. Alexi `package.json` shows `"vitest": "^4.1.11"` (below patched version). Fix: bump to `^5.0.5` (or at least `^4.1.12` if 5.x has breaking changes).

- **Why**: Alexi on vitest 4.1.11, below the patched 4.1.12 threshold. Security advisories GHSA-qxg6-89mg-rqv8 and GHSA-xp26-3454-mjgp are CVE-tracked (details not in commit message, but Dependabot flagged them). Benefits: (1) Patch two CVEs in test infrastructure, (2) Align with upstream Kilocode (5.0.5), (3) Stay current with vitest ecosystem (5.x is stable). Implementation: bump `vitest` in `package.json` to `^5.0.5`, run `npm install`, verify `npm test` and `npm run test:coverage` pass, check for breaking changes in vitest 5.x migration guide if any test failures surface. Size SMALL ~1-2h (bump dep, verify tests, fix any vitest 5.x compat issues if present). Priority HIGH (security advisories in deps, CI already enforces coverage thresholds so a broken upgrade surfaces immediately).

- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/15437 (Vitest 5.0.5 upstream, merged 2026-10-23), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/package.json (Alexi vitest 4.1.11), https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-qxg6-89mg-rqv8 (vitest advisory 1, patched in 4.1.12+), https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-xp26-3454-mjgp (vitest advisory 2, patched in 4.1.12+)

- **Category**: deps (security, vitest, test-infrastructure)

- **Size**: SMALL ~1-2h. Bump vitest to `^5.0.5` in `package.json`, run `npm install`, verify `npm test` && `npm run test:coverage` pass, check vitest 5.x migration guide if test failures surface. Priority HIGH (security advisories, easy upgrade).

#### 2. SST plugin activation wait CLI-ACTIONABLE (core, plugin, runner, race-condition, command-not-found)

- **What**: SST OpenCode PR #51133 (merged 2026-10-24, co-authored by Daniel Smolsky) adds `await activation` before each runner step. Issue: runner steps (tool calls, script executions) could race with plugin activation. If a plugin-provided tool (e.g. an MCP command, a hook-registered script) is invoked before the plugin fully activates, the runner surfaces "command not found" or "tool not available" even though the plugin config is valid. This is a heisenbug (works when plugin starts fast, fails when slow network / cold start). Fix: `await activation` before each runner step ensures plugins finish initializing before tools are invoked. Pattern: explicit activation gate at runner step boundary, not just session start.

- **Why**: Alexi has plugin system (`src/plugin/`) and runner orchestration (`src/core/agenticChat.ts`, `src/core/orchestrator.ts`). Check if Alexi waits for plugin activation before tool invocation. If not, same race exists: fast machines hide the bug, slow CI or network hiccups surface "tool not found" for plugin-provided tools. Implementation: (1) Audit `src/plugin/` for activation lifecycle (async `init`, `load`, `activate` methods), (2) Audit runner step invocation in `src/core/agenticChat.ts` and tool dispatch in `src/tool/registry.ts` for activation gates, (3) If missing, add `await pluginManager.ensureActivated()` (or equivalent) before tool dispatch / runner step execution, (4) Add test: plugin with slow activation (setTimeout 100ms) + tool invocation immediately after session start (should succeed, not fail with "not found"). Size MEDIUM ~4-6h (audit plugin lifecycle + runner step boundary, add activation gate if missing, write async activation test, verify no heisenbug on slow machines). Priority MEDIUM (fixes heisenbug, improves reliability, but not user-reported in Alexi yet; proactive hardening).

- **Source**: https://github.com/sst/opencode/pull/51133 (plugin activation wait upstream, merged 2026-10-24), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/plugin/ (Alexi plugin system, audit needed for activation lifecycle), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/agenticChat.ts (Alexi runner orchestration, audit needed for activation gate), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/tool/registry.ts (Alexi tool dispatch, audit needed for plugin-tool readiness check)

- **Category**: core (plugin, runner, race-condition, command-not-found)

- **Size**: MEDIUM ~4-6h. Audit plugin activation lifecycle (`src/plugin/`), audit runner step boundary for activation gate (`src/core/agenticChat.ts`, `src/tool/registry.ts`), add `await ensureActivated()` if missing, write test (slow plugin + immediate tool call). Priority MEDIUM (heisenbug fix, proactive reliability improvement).

#### 3. Kilocode MCP SSE probe scope fixes REFERENCE-ONLY (mcp, sse, probe, oauth, redirect, remote-transport)

- **What**: Kilocode commits 4324620 and 70354f0 (merged 2026-10-23) fix two MCP SSE probe bugs for remote transport. (1) **Scope the Accept header normalization** (commit 4324620): issue: origin-wide SSE probe rewrote ALL same-origin requests (including OAuth discovery) with `Accept: text/event-stream`, so valid JSON metadata endpoints returned 405 (OAuth discovery failed). Fix: only normalize the stream request itself and SDK-followed same-origin redirects (record redirect targets from 3xx response, compare request URL to recorded targets). Add regression tests for SDK discovery with configured header, same-origin JSON GET at custom metadata path, two-hop redirect chain. (2) **Compare origins not full URL** (commit 70354f0): issue: SDK 1.32.1 follows same-origin redirects itself and calls custom fetch again with redirect target URL. Probe compared full URL to endpoint, so a 200 non-SSE body at redirect target passed probe → transport reconnected forever. Fix: compare origins instead (Accept check still keeps OAuth requests out). Note cross-origin redirect behavior change in changeset.

- **Why**: Alexi `src/mcp/sse-probe.ts` has `classifyProbeContentType` (case-insensitive content-type matching, already ported from upstream). Alexi `src/mcp/client.ts` remote-transport probe (`connectRemote` line 1421) uses `HEAD` with no custom Accept header (no `text/event-stream` injection, so no OAuth rewrite risk). Alexi probe compares origins not full URLs for remote endpoints (line 1441-1445 uses `fetch(config.url!)` with no URL comparison). REFERENCE-ONLY: when Alexi adds real SSE/streamable-HTTP transport wiring (replaces `HEAD` probe with GET + SSE handshake, adds custom Accept header for SSE detection), reference these fixes: (1) Scope Accept normalization to stream request + SDK-followed redirects only (record redirect targets, compare request URL to targets), (2) Compare origins not full URL for SDK-followed redirects (SDK 1.32.1+ calls custom fetch again with redirect target). Current priority SKIP (Alexi remote MCP transport not yet implemented, `HEAD` probe has no Accept injection, no OAuth rewrite bug). Pattern reference for future SSE transport wiring.

- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/4324620882fa37e3e725c2ede78d5d6317cdd733 (MCP SSE probe scope upstream, 2026-10-23), https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/70354f039b2eae23f290bb721ad168990d96e864 (MCP SSE redirect origin upstream, 2026-10-23), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/mcp/sse-probe.ts (Alexi SSE probe classifier, case-insensitive matching already ported), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/mcp/client.ts:1421 (Alexi remote probe, HEAD with no Accept header, no OAuth rewrite risk)

- **Category**: N/A (mcp, sse, probe, oauth, redirect, remote-transport, reference-only)

- **Size**: SKIP. Alexi remote MCP probe uses HEAD (no Accept header, no OAuth rewrite risk). Pattern reference for future SSE/streamable-HTTP transport wiring (scope Accept normalization to stream request + redirects, compare origins not full URL for SDK-followed redirects).

#### 4. Cline desktop Cloud model defaulting SKIP (desktop, cloud, clinepass, model-selection, vs-code)

- **What**: Cline PR #15320 (merged 2026-10-24) improves Cloud chat model defaulting for desktop. Issue: new Cloud chats did not carry over local ClinePass model, and fallback logic was unclear (landed on catalog's first entry, not user-appropriate model). Fix: (1) Carry over local Cline model AND local ClinePass model to Cloud. (2) When Cloud catalog does not offer the starting model: ClinePass users start on first ClinePass model, everyone else on `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5` (not catalog's first entry). (3) Only remember explicit Cloud model picks; automatic fallbacks stay defaults (next Cloud chat follows local model). (4) Reverted plan-check gating (cline_pass_subscribed sidecar command dropped; local ClinePass free models carry over again). Pattern: provider-aware fallback logic, explicit vs automatic model selection.

- **Why**: Alexi is CLI-only (no desktop app, no Cloud provider, no ClinePass integration, no VS Code extension). Model selection in Alexi is CLI args (`-m`, `--model`) and `routing-config.json` (no Cloud fallback, no ClinePass plan check). SKIP. Pattern reference if Alexi adds Cloud provider or multi-tier model selection: fallback logic based on user's subscription tier, remember explicit picks vs automatic fallbacks, provider-aware defaults.

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15320 (desktop Cloud model defaulting upstream, merged 2026-10-24), docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (Alexi architecture, CLI-only, no desktop/Cloud/ClinePass)

#### 5. SST OpenCode assorted fixes REFERENCE-ONLY (ai, providers, tui, core, streaming, error-handling, forward-compat, perf)

- **What**: SST OpenCode merged 10 fixes on 2026-10-24, mostly provider hardening + UI polish: (1) **Strip ANSI from tool errors/output** (#58545): tool error messages and generic output sent to LLM context now strip ANSI escape codes (no garbled `\x1b[31m` in prompt). (2) **Classify OpenAI image moderation blocks as content_policy** (#58544): OpenAI image moderation rejections surface as `content_policy` error type (not generic error), enables correct retry logic (do not retry content policy). (3) **Ignore unknown OpenAI image stream events** (#58596): forward-compat for new OpenAI image streaming event types (unknown events logged + skipped, not thrown). (4) **Ignore unknown OpenAI speech stream events** (#58609): same for speech streaming. (5) **Map unknown OpenAI Chat finish reasons to unknown** (#58608): unrecognized finish reasons map to `unknown` (not unhandled exception). (6) **Forward native Google video URLs** (#58612): Gemini video input accepts native video URLs (not just base64). (7) **Offer GPT-Live through OpenCode Console connection without OpenAI key** (#58567): GPT-Live (realtime voice) available via hosted OpenCode Console relay (no user OpenAI key needed). (8) **Show Go allowance when session costs nothing** (#58566 app, #58565 TUI, #58562 core): UI shows Go allowance for free sessions (not just paid cost). (9) **Resolve git binary once on macOS** (#58602): cache git binary path (perf). (10) **Resolve prompt hook model once per step** (#58601): cache model resolution (perf). (11) **Skip no-op Azure model transform updates** (#58600): avoid redundant Azure model ID transforms (perf).

- **Why**: Alexi provider layer (`src/providers/`) and error handling (`src/core/error-backoff.ts`) can reference these patterns: (1) **Strip ANSI from tool output**: if Alexi tool outputs (bash, browser, etc.) contain ANSI escape codes (color/formatting), strip before sending to LLM (upstream pattern: regex `\x1b\[[0-9;]*m` or npm package `strip-ansi`). (2) **Classify provider errors by type**: OpenAI image moderation → `content_policy` (not `generic_error`); enables correct retry logic (permanent vs transient). Alexi `classifyError` in `src/core/error-backoff.ts` can add content-policy detection (`moderation`, `content_filter`, `content_policy` message substrings). (3) **Forward-compat streaming events**: ignore unknown event types instead of throwing (log + skip). Alexi streaming orchestrators (`src/core/streamingOrchestrator.ts`) can add unknown-event fallback. (4) **Cache expensive lookups**: git binary path, model resolution, repeated transforms (perf). Alexi can cache git path on first use. All REFERENCE-ONLY (no user-reported issues in Alexi, proactive hardening). Patterns: provider error classification, forward-compat streaming, ANSI stripping, caching.

- **Source**: https://github.com/sst/opencode/pull/58545 (strip ANSI upstream), https://github.com/sst/opencode/pull/58544 (OpenAI moderation classification upstream), https://github.com/sst/opencode/pull/58596 (OpenAI image events upstream), https://github.com/sst/opencode/pull/58609 (OpenAI speech events upstream), https://github.com/sst/opencode/pull/58608 (OpenAI finish reasons upstream), https://github.com/sst/opencode/pull/58612 (Google video URLs upstream), https://github.com/sst/opencode/pull/58567 (GPT-Live Console upstream), https://github.com/sst/opencode/pull/58566 (Go allowance app upstream), https://github.com/sst/opencode/pull/58565 (Go allowance TUI upstream), https://github.com/sst/opencode/pull/58562 (Go allowance core upstream), https://github.com/sst/opencode/pull/58602 (git binary cache upstream), https://github.com/sst/opencode/pull/58601 (prompt hook model cache upstream), https://github.com/sst/opencode/pull/58600 (Azure no-op skip upstream), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/providers/ (Alexi providers, error classification), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/error-backoff.ts (Alexi error classification), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/streamingOrchestrator.ts (Alexi streaming, unknown event handling), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/tool/tools/bash.ts (Alexi bash tool, ANSI output)
